units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:1:3">Y. Sabb. IV, beg. 6ᵈ</cite> <he>כמרה גו ק׳ ויהבא ק׳ וכ׳</he> to keep it warm, put it in a large vessel, and put the vessel on peat (<cite ref="C00799"><he>גִּיפְתָּא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:25">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>יאות … זכותיה גו קוּפְתֵיה</he> (not <cite ref="S00525"><he>קופתה</he></cite>) well the millers say, every man carries his worth in his own tub, i.e. there is a different way of doing good for every man; a. e.—Pl., v. <cite ref="S00491"><he>קוּפָּא</he> I</cite>.
